descriptionChirho: Noun meaning 'fleece,' the shorn wool of a sheep. All 7 occurrences appear in the Gideon narrative (Judges 6:37-40) referring to the fleece used in his sign from God. The definite form with article (eng: the-fleece, with-the-fleece, spa: el-vellon, con-el-vellon, hin: ऊन-के, arb: الْجَزَّةِ, kor: 양털에, swa: manyoya) and the construct form (eng: fleece-of, spa: vellon-de, hin: ऊन, arb: جَزَّةَ, kor: 양털을, swa: manyoya-ya) express the same semantic content across all syntactic positions.
